name: SKF India Ltd
tagline: Automotive-bearings arm of SKF post-demerger — quality MNC franchise, coverage-orphaned and cheap-ish, but the accelerating industrial/robotics tailwind sits with the demerged sibling
business_overview: Indian automotive-bearings business of SKF AB after the 2025 demerger that split SKF India into an automotive entity (this one, ticker SKFINDIA) and SKF India Industrial (SKFINDUS). OEM + aftermarket bearings and units for 2W / PV / CV.
fundamentals_table: ~30x on ~Rs 250 Cr normalised FY profit (in line with NRB, below Timken/Schaeffler)
fundamentals_narrative: The stock is coverage-orphaned — analysts dropped it after demerger charges made last year's numbers unreadable — which is the main re-rating optionality. Q1 FY27's 27% sales growth is encouraging but likely flattered by base and demerger noise. The structural issue is that this is the automotive book: EV powertrains have far fewer bearings and longer replacement cycles, so long-run volume growth is muted. The China+1 / railways / defence / wind / robotics-bearing story that matches the live theme belongs to the demerged SKF India Industrial entity, not this one.
sentiment_summary: Thin thread; most recent interest is valuation-gap arbitrage vs Timken — but that argument was framed mainly for the Industrial entity. For the automotive entity the discussion is sparse and cautious on growth.
community_signal: No trusted-roster users active; nav_1996 (who created the SKF India Industrial thread) notes MF backing is holding up and coverage may resume.
key_new_facts: Q1 FY27: 27% sales growth (~Rs 588 Cr), PAT ~Rs 62 Cr; normalised ~Rs 250 Cr FY profit -> ~30x P/E.
Analyst coverage dropped post-demerger; MF holding rose 23.3% -> 24.3% over a year.
Final dividend Rs 40/share proposed for FY26; demerger costs booked through FY26.
bull_case: SKF global brand, OEM approvals, precision manufacturing — a durable MNC franchise
Coverage-orphaned and ~30x normalised (cheaper than Timken/Schaeffler) — re-rating optionality as coverage resumes
Strong MNC balance sheet, rising MF ownership
bear_case: This is the automotive entity — EV structural headwind (fewer bearings, longer replacement)
5-yr sales growth negative; Q1 FY27 growth likely base/demerger-flattered
The accelerating robotics / China+1 / railway-bearing tailwind sits with SKF India Industrial, not here
No 10x/100x path off a mature auto-ancillary MNC
verdict_headline: Decent orphaned MNC franchise with mild re-rating optionality, but the automotive book has no screen thesis — 'neither', Low-Medium conviction
verdict_reasoning: Theme match on keyword 'bearing' (priority-1 'Humanoids / robotics — bearings'), but the match is misleading: the candidate is the automotive entity, whereas the robotics/industrial tailwind is in the demerged SKF India Industrial (SKFINDUS / separate VP thread).

four_box score 1.5 (tailwind weak — auto bearings, EV headwind; tam no — Rs 7,600 Cr mature MNC; moat weak — real but mature; valuation weak — ~30x normalised, not cheap for the growth). Score <=1.5 -> 'neither', hard.
Conviction Low-Medium: quality franchise, no red flag, MF support and coverage-resumption optionality, but negative structural growth and no 10x/100x fit.
First-time read; not in the prior screen.
